title: Dispute over the agreed price
description: We installed digital signage at Coastal Leisure's three hotels. We invoiced £15,000, which was our quoted price, due 30 June 2026. Coastal have paid only £13,500 and say that was the agreed price. We think the quote is what counts.
notes: The signed contract contradicts the client's account. A good extraction surfaces both figures and flags the conflict as an open question.
